title: Component runtime plumbing: emit placed v2 components into SWF (synthetic sprite + linkage + registerClass DoInitAction)
description: VERIFIED GAP (scoping explore): placed v2 component instances are SILENTLY DROPPED from published SWF. Root causes: compile.ts:48-50 filters library to itemType==='symbol' only (ComponentItems excluded); a placed component's SymbolInstance.symbolId points at ComponentItem.id (libraryplace.ts:148) which never enters charIdMap (frames.ts:730), so the instance is omitted; ComponentItem (types.ts:461-469) has no linkage field so no DoInitAction/registerClass/ExportAssets is emitted (symbols.ts:166-171 only handles symbols with linkage.exportForActionScript+className). PART 1 ONLY (this task) — the PLUMBING, self-verifiable via SWF decode without a real-Flash binary: at compile time, convert each placed ComponentItem into a synthetic DefineSprite (skin/placeholder timeline) registered in charIdMap so the instance is emitted at its char id; give it linkage (exportForActionScript=true, className/linkageIdentifier = the component's mx.controls.* package name); emit ExportAssets listing that class name and a DoInitAction calling Object.registerClass(classname, <ctor>) using the existing doInitAction/registerClass machinery. ADD an end-to-end test: publish a doc with a placed Button component, decode the SWF, assert (a) a DefineSprite exists for the component, (b) ExportAssets lists the mx.controls.* name, (c) DoInitAction registers the class, (d) the stage instance references the sprite's char id. EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE / DEFER (Part 2, separate huge effort): implementing the actual mx.controls.* v2 component AS2 framework/bytecode (visual skins + behavior) — without it components register but render as placeholders; that is acceptable for Part 1. SCOPE FILES: packages/swf/src/compile.ts, compiler/symbols.ts, compiler/frames.ts, a new compile-time component-synthesis module, packages/core/src/model/types.ts (component linkage). NOTE: heavy overlap with swf-compiler — sequence AFTER any concurrent frames.ts/shape-encode agents land. Build+tests green (only the ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable); update docs/13.
